description:
CPU replay engines, plain Java with no optional runtime dependency so they are
    always available. Two paths: a scalar interpreter (the portable fallback and the
    deterministic CPU oracle an accelerated result is checked against, path-for-path on the
    same Philox stream), and a bytecode-generating engine that emits the tape as a
    tape-specific class via the Class-File API (final since JDK 24) — straight-line forward
    and reverse sweeps, segmented to stay inside HotSpot C2 limits. No incubator module, no
    native library; the LTS-Java-clean default fast path.
